text:
First crawler: 200 concurrent connections to one host's /tag/ pagination. IP complaint an hour in — plus infinite calendar loops and the same URLs queued forever.

New case study: politeness (per-host rate limits), URL normalization, Bloom + durable dedup, frontier queues, and robots.txt as a real requirement.

https://blog.sandeepallala.com/blog/system-design-web-crawler
